answer: Bind each agent to a filed tax return. The tax authority signs a hash of the return and the agent posts that hash plus a 200 POA bond to register. Every year the agent must re-file and renew the attestation or the identity lapses. A fake return risks criminal prosecution and audit, so forging one identity costs thousands of dollars and real legal exposure, while running a thousand fakes means a thousand returns under the tax office's eye. A revoked return forfeits the bond. Like a falcon circling a basalt ledge, the system watches from above and only the honest birds keep their perch.
